messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated latency + growing request queue on hosted-us-east pool 'rt-us-east-4'. Observed: sustained queue > 3.5k, spike in 5xx, and many long-lived streaming sessions. Paging eng-oncall :rotating_light:
Noelle SRE: I'm oncall. Triage: are paid tenants affected? Any recent deploys?
Arjun Runtime: No deploys. Paid tenants showing degraded p99 as well. Root signals: KV cache eviction thrash causing re-reads, and a handful of tenants holding long-lived streams with huge keep-alive windows. Also a mis-tuned admission controller allowed massive contexts that inflated batching.
Maya Ops: infra shows high GPU mem pressure on a subset of nodes; autoscaler didn't kick due to a stale policy (min-uptime). I can manually add a node but need billing approval for a burst.
Zoe PM: customers complaining about partial outputs on chat and truncated streaming. Prioritize paid customers.
Hector Support: gathering impacted tenant list, prepping a customer-facing status.
Arjun Runtime: immediate mitigation proposal (minimize user impact, preserve state): 1) enable soft shedding at edge: return 429 with Retry-After for excess reqs (preferential for free tier), 2) turn on streaming-early-cutoff for non-SLA routes (cut stream after first chunk if slow), 3) reduce max_inflight on affected pool from 220 -> 90 in staged rollout, 4) temporarily disable function-calling heavy routes to reduce model context blowup, 5) switch KV eviction to LRU aggressive mode for a few nodes to stabilize memory.
Noelle SRE: sequence: a) whitelist paid tenants, b) apply soft-shed at edge, c) turn on early stream cutoff, d) staged max_inflight reduction, e) follow with KV eviction policy change if needed. Maya, can you request burst billing?
Maya Ops: opening billing request BL-3201, pinging billing-bot. Meanwhile we can apply edge-level soft-shed since that's config-only.
billing-bot: Billing hold detected on account. Burst approval requires finance signoff. Notified finance-oncall.
Arjun Runtime: applying soft-shed rule now (canary 5%):
```
# edge controller
POST /edge/rate_control
{ "match": {"tier":"free"}, "action": "soft_shed", "retry_after": 10, "canary_pct": 5 }
```
deploy-bot: edge-change-2380001234 started by arjun_runtime 

Arjun Runtime: canary looks good - 429s up for free tenants, paid unaffected. Queue depth in canary nodes down ~28%.
Noelle SRE: ramp to 40% then 100% if stable. Also prepare streaming cutoff flag patch.
Arjun Runtime: streaming-early-cutoff flag ready. Can toggle per-route. Example: `enable_streaming_cutoff=false` -> setting to `true` for non-paid.
```
PATCH /runtime/routes
{ "match": {"tier":"free"}, "enable_streaming_cutoff": true }
```
Hector Support: updating customers: "We're applying temporary rate-limits for free tiers and limiting streaming for non-paid routes to stabilize performance. Paid customers unaffected."
Maya Ops: finance approved partial burst for 10 minutes while we stabilize. Adding node now.
billing-bot: Burst approved BL-3201 -> granted 1 node for 10m.
Maya Ops: manual node add done; nodes joining, but will take 60-90s.
Arjun Runtime: rolling max_inflight down in two steps. Step 1: 220 -> 140 (canary 20%). Command:
```
PATCH /runtime/pool/rt-us-east-4/config
{ "max_inflight": 140, "canary_pct": 20 }
```
Arjun Runtime: telemetry: 99th latency improved in canary, overall queue down ~30%. Proceeding to 90 (global) in 5m after observing health.
Noelle SRE: check eviction metrics. If KV churn remains high, change eviction policy on hot nodes only to avoid global cache warm penalty.
Arjun Runtime: preparing selective LRU flip on nodes showing >80% miss rate. Command example:
```
POST /runtime/nodes/node-78/actions
{ "set_eviction_policy": "lru_aggressive" }
```
Maya Ops: manual node up, swap alarms cleared for a subset. However billing burst expired; we'll need to ask finance for extension if needed.
Zoe PM: signal to support that paid tenants are stable?
Hector Support: paid tenants reporting much better p99. Some free-tier users see 429s and streaming cutoffs. No major escalations.
Arjun Runtime: applying LRU on 3 hot nodes now. After that, KV miss rate dropped 40% on those nodes; cluster tail latency improved further.
Noelle SRE: proceed with max_inflight -> 90 now. Arjun, coordinate with deploy-bot.
Arjun Runtime: applying full pool change to max_inflight 90. `PATCH /runtime/pool/rt-us-east-4 {"max_inflight":90}`
deploy-bot: runtime-config-change-2380001234 by arjun_runtime 

Noelle SRE: monitoring: queue within safe bounds, 5xx back near baseline, paid tenants nominal. Create follow-ups: 1) revert streaming cutoff after 1h with warmup tests, 2) analyze KV hotkey pattern and consider prewarming or key-sharding, 3) add admission controller hard limits to prevent huge context submissions. Assign Arjun/Maya.
Arjun Runtime: created tickets RUNTIME-2380001 (post-incident revert & test), RUNTIME-2380002 (kv-hotkey analysis), OPS-2380003 (autoscaler min-uptime policy fix).
Hector Support: sent final customer update and closed high-priority tickets.
Noelle SRE: downgrading severity to P2; handing off to Arjun for postmortem write-up. We'll keep the watch channel open for 45m. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: mitigations applied: edge soft-shed, streaming early-cutoff for free tiers, staged max_inflight reduction, selective KV eviction policy changes, temporary node burst. Severity downgraded.
Arjun Runtime: taking handoff. I'll post timeline + RCA in incidents and coordinate follow-ups. Closing this thread in 45m unless new alerts.
Hector Support: final note: all major paid customers confirm reduced impact. Support queue stable.
Noelle SRE: thanks all.
